name: Enigmatig Limited
summary: Enigmatig Limited, along with its associated companies, delivers expert advisory solutions tailored for financial institutions across key Asian markets, including Singapore, Hong Kong, and mainland China. The firm specializes in several core areas: Regulatory Licensing: Offering strategic guidance on establishing robust business plans, developing comprehensive operational, risk management, and compliance manuals, and assisting clients with market entry, client acquisition, and negotiation support. Corporate Governance & Administrative Support: Providing essential services such as the submission of regulatory filings, meticulous maintenance of corporate registers, preparation of articles of incorporation, coordination with financial institutions for new bank account openings, and compiling necessary regulatory documentation for new entity formation. Additionally, Enigmatig offers a range of supplementary services including management consultancy, client relationship management (CRM) software solutions, financial technology (fintech) advisory, and the formation and administration of international business companies (IBCs). Established in 2010 and based in Singapore, the company previously operated as Desfran Holdings Limited before adopting its current name, Enigmatig Limited, in April 2024.
